basic_details.job_title: DCPU Chengalpattu Support Person Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 20 Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Child Protection Unit, Chengalpattu (DCPU Chengalpattu) has announced 20 temporary vacancies for the Support Person post, with the application last date set for 30 October 2026 starting from 16 October 2026. Candidates can apply offline by sending their completed application forms directly, by post, or by courier to the District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, Room No. F0-06, Ground Floor, F-Block. Engagement for these positions is purely temporary for deployment in Chengalpattu. Applicants must hold a Post Graduate Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psyc

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Any person with a Post Graduate Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development or any other relevant field related to child welfare, health or education, or a graduate with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in child education, development, health or protection issues.

selection_process: The official notification does not specify a written test or interview process; engagement is based on application review and eligibility verification by the District Child Protection Unit.
important_instructions: Applications that are incomplete or submitted without the required supporting documents will be rejected without prior notice. No correspondence regarding such rejections will be entertained. The engagement will be purely temporary. Applications must reach the specified address between 16/10/2026 and 30/10/2026 on or before 5:45 PM.

content_sections.heading: DCPU Chengalpattu Support Person at a Glance

rows.details: Post Graduate Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development, or relevant field, OR Graduate with 3 years' experience

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must send their completed application forms along with all required enclosures to the following postal address: District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, Room No. F0-06, Ground Floor, F-Block, New District Collectorate Campus, Chengalpattu - 603 111. Contact Number for inquiries: 6382613163.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Any person with a Post Graduate Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development or any other relevant field related to child welfare, health or education, or a graduate with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in child education, development, health or protection issues.

content_sections.heading: DCPU Chengalpattu Support Person Job Description
content_sections.text: Support Persons are engaged to provide necessary support and guidance to children affected by sexual offences under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012, during investigation and court proceedings.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Copies of all relevant educational qualification certificates Experience certificates Recent photograph

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify a written test or interview process; engagement is based on application review and eligibility verification by the District Child Protection Unit.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications that are incomplete or submitted without the required supporting documents will be rejected without prior notice. No correspondence regarding such rejections will be entertained. The engagement will be purely temporary. Applications must reach the specified address between 16/10/2026 and 30/10/2026 on or before 5:45 PM.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for Support Persons?
faq.answer: There are a total of 20 vacancies available for the Support Person post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form is 30 October 2026 on or before 5:45 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualification is required for this post?
faq.answer: Applicants must have a Post Graduate Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development or related fields, or a graduate degree with at least 3 years of experience in child education, development, health, or protection issues.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an upper age limit specified in the notification?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limit for applicants.

faq.question: Q5. What is the honorarium or pay offered for the Support Person position?
faq.answer: The honorarium is Rs. 10,000/- per case, payable in 4 instalments.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates submit their application forms?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their completed application forms along with relevant certificates by direct submission, post, or courier to the designated DCPU Chengalpattu office address.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement for Support Persons is purely temporary.

faq.question: Q8. Where can candidates download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website at http://chengalpattu.nic.in.
